info.title: Express Server - Dynamic Data API
info.description:
Edge server providing real-time data retrieval from a NoSQL MongoDB database.
    Optimized for speed and handling frequently changing information.

get.summary: Retrieve reviews with optional filtering and pagination
get.description:
Fetches a paginated list of movie reviews. Supports filtering by Top Critic status, review type, 
 a date range, and movie title.

parameters.name: criticFilter
parameters.description: Filter reviews by Top Critic status (true for Top Critic reviews).

parameters.name: typeFilter
parameters.description: Filter reviews by a specific type or category (fresh or rotten)

parameters.name: minDateFilter
parameters.description: Filter reviews published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: maxDateFilter
parameters.description: Filter reviews published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: reviewMovieFilter
parameters.description: Filter reviews where the movie title contains this string (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (results per page: 10).

200.description: A list of reviews retrieved successfully.

500.description: Internal Server Error - An unexpected error occurred on the server.

example.error_message: Internal Server Error: Failed to retrieve reviews.

post.summary: Create a new discussion room for a specific movie
post.description: Initiates a new discussion thread related to a particular movie, allowing fans to join and chat

500.description: Internal Server Error - An unexpected error occurred while creating the discussion.

example.error_message: Internal Server Error: Failed to create new discussion.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of discussion rooms, with optional filtering by movie title and sorting by creation date

200.description: A list of discussion rooms retrieved successfully

500.description: Internal Server Error - An unexpected error occurred while retrieving discussions.

example.error_message: Internal Server Error: Failed to retrieve discussions.

get.summary: Retrieve the latest messages from a specific discussion room
get.description: Fetches a paginated list of the most recent messages within a given discussion room.

parameters.name: id_room
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the discussion room

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (results per page: 50).

200.description: A list of last messages retrieved successfully

example.error_message: Bad Request: Missing the required parameter id_room or pageNumber.

404.description: Not Found - Discussion room not found for the specified ID.

example.error_message: Not Found: Discussion room with the specified ID does not exist.

500.description: Internal Server Error - An unexpected error occurred while retrieving messages.

example.error_message: Internal Server Error: Failed to retrieve messages.

post.summary: Send a new text message to a discussion room
post.description: Publishes a new text message to the specified discussion room, broadcasting it to all connected members

200.description: Message sent successfully to the discussion room.

400.description: Bad Request - Missing required parameters in the request body.

example.error_message: Bad Request: Missing required fields in the message payload.

404.description: Not Found - Discussion room not found for the specified ID.

example.error_message: Not Found: Discussion room with the specified ID does not exist.

500.description: Internal Server Error - An unexpected error occurred while sending the message.

example.error_message: Internal Server Error: Failed to send the message.

post.summary: Send a new image or video message to a discussion room
post.description: Publishes a new image or video message to the specified discussion room, broadcasting it to all connected members

200.description: Image/video message sent successfully to the discussion room.

400.description: Bad Request - Missing required parameters in the request body.

example.error_message: Bad Request: Missing required fields in the image/video message payload.

404.description: Not Found - Discussion room not found for the specified ID.

example.error_message: Not Found: Discussion room with the specified ID does not exist.

500.description: Internal Server Error - An unexpected error occurred while sending the image/video message.

example.error_message: Internal Server Error: Failed to send the image/video message.
